derived_candidates.text: Bernoulli noted that logarithmic spirals are self-similar, meaning they remain congruent under similarity transformations.
Logarithmic growth is described as the inverse of exponential growth and is very slow.
The logarithmic norm was introduced by Germund Dahlquist and Sergei Lozinskiĭ in 1958 for square matrices.
